title: Madhya Pradesh Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, 1993
eligibility: Rural residents registered in Gram Sabha electoral rolls of MP
benefits: Direct democratic participation through Gram Sabha meetings
Right to audit local development funds and village welfare schemes
application_process: Step 1: Attend mandatory quarterly Gram Sabha meetings.
Step 2: Submit local development proposals or grievances directly to Gram Panchayat Secretary.
important_sections_or_clauses: Section 6: Functions and powers of Gram Sabha
Section 7: Social audit of rural welfare works and beneficiary selection
